analysis.title: US EQUITIES COLOR: SOGGY
key_insights: US equities closed lower with S&P -49bps at 7,201 and NDX -199bps at 26,214, while R2K +59bps and Dow +86bps outperformed. S&P Equal Weight and RTY outperformed.
NVDA and ANT both fell about 7% and set the tone for Tech/AI. Desk flow was driven by top-down net exposure management via ETFs and baskets.

Bartlett frames the question as whether Semis and AI-Infra need estimate cuts to bottom, since most expected positive AI catalysts into year-end (financing deals, earnings, ANT, Jensen return) failed to lift multiples.
Floor activity was 4 on a 1-10 scale. HF flows were balanced and Asset Managers were moderate net sellers. MOC was $7.4bn to BUY.
Continued supply in NVDA (multiple long-only sellers) and pockets of Memory, with limited defense on the desk. There was little demand yesterday on the 14% SOX bounce.
ETFs were 36% of the tape, with SOXX, SOXL, SMH and DRAM trading elevated volumes.
Consumer earnings were generally positive (DKS, KSS, BURL, ANF, DLTR).
Post bell, DELL was unchanged after being +4%. It raised FY EPS guide by 16% with a big beat on AI servers and ISG operating margins up about 2pts q/q.
GS expects October PCE tomorrow with core PCE +0.29% m/m (+3.24% y/y) and headline +0.32% m/m (+3.83% y/y).
Derivs desk: flows tapered ahead of Thanksgiving. SPX fixed strike vols closed moderately offered, gamma tenors were hammered into the close, and skew relaxed in the front and belly.
Desk likes call spread collars and put spread collars. Short vol bias structures are preferred given how quickly vol comes in on rallies.
Single-stock activity: sizable underwrites followed the ANT mega IPO, with customers selling 29.2k ANT Jan 40 puts. GS customers bought 60k VIX Dec 18 puts.
